description: A simple and effective daily skincare routine for beginners, focusing on hydration and protection. This routine can be easily adapted based on individual skin type and concerns.

morning_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and excess oils without stripping the skin's natural barrier.
Lock in moisture and provide essential hydration to maintain healthy skin.

night_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and excess oils without stripping the skin's natural barrier.

night_steps.action: Apply a serum or treatment product (if needed).
night_steps.purpose: Target specific concerns such as fine lines, hyperpigmentation, or acne.
Moisturize the skin before bedtime to keep it hydrated overnight.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliate once a week using a gentle physical or chemical exfoliant.

do: Hydrate the skin regularly, especially in dry climates or during winter months.
dont: Over-exfoliate as it can irritate the skin and cause redness or peeling.
Skip moisturizing, even if you have oily skin. All skin types benefit from hydration.
common_mistakes: Not patch testing new products before full application.
Overusing active ingredients like retinol without consulting a dermatologist.

expected_results.2_weeks: Improved skin texture and reduced dryness.
expected_results.1_month: Healthier-looking skin with enhanced hydration levels.
expected_results.3_months: Reduced appearance of fine lines and increased overall skin elasticity.

expert_tips: Listen to your skin and adjust the routine as needed based on its response.
Use sunscreen daily, even when it’s cloudy, to protect against UV damage.
